senses.gloss: m. (τάξις; inflected like a native word, formed like עָצִיץ, as if fr. טכס) order, array, order of battle; arrangement. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 66ᵇ בט׳ מלכים Ar. (ed. … בטכסיסי של, read: בטַכְסִיסִין, pl.) in the order in which kings go to war; Tanḥ. Bo. 4 כטקסין של וכ׳; ed. Bub. ib. 4 בטכסיס מלך וכ׳; Pesik. R. S. 17 בטַכְסִיסֵי מלכים (pl. constr.).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12:5">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>בטק׳ המלכים</he> in the order of a royal (regular) army.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8:3">Ex. R. s. 8</cite>, end <he>בט׳ הזה הבא וכ׳</he> in this consecutive order bring &c.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 9 <he>בטקסין הזה הביא</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite> <he>בט׳ של נבואה</he> under the order of prophecy.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:25">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>בט׳ גְּדוּלָּה</he> (not <he>בטקסים</he>) in the array of power (arrogating power to themselves); Tanḥ. B’haăl. 14 <he>בטקסים גדולים</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:25">Ib.</cite> B’midb. 12 <he>יש להם טכסין מן יעקב אביהן</he> they have a traditional order from the way their father Jacob arranged his funeral escort; ed. Bub. ib. 12 <he>יש בידן טכסיס אביהן</he>.
Cant. R. to II, 4 טקסים של מעלה (read … ס) the heavenly array; a. v. fr.—2) (fem.) garrison.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:5">Y. Ab. Zar. I 39ᶜ</cite>, <he>הדא טק׳ דקסרין</he> the garrison of Caesarea, v. <cite ref="D00332"><he>דּוּקִים</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>טַכְסִיסִין</he>, <cite ref="I00423"><he>טַקְ׳</he></cite>, constr. <he>טַכְסִיסֵי</he>, <cite ref="I00423"><he>טַקְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 17:1">Pesik. R. s. 17</cite>, a. e., v. supra.
